title: Castro welcomes Marcos Jr.'s 'endorsement' of 'Ante Kler' nickname
summary: For the first time since appointing her, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has addressed Palace Press Officer Claire Castro as "Ante Kler" — a moniker that many in the public use for her.
